messages:
Zoe Park: Morning all 44b First day on ML infra (remote, Seoul). Two quick setup things and one fun ask: 1) VPN / MFA for APAC remote  any gotchas? 2) hardware stipend and Mac vs Linux devbox guidance? 3) also, is there a tiny tradition for new hires (I collect quirky socks) 

Harpreet (IT): Welcome Zoe 389 For APAC we use WireGuard + Okta MFA. Main gotcha: time-based MFA apps sometimes need clock sync on old Android phones. I'll DM a prebuilt wg0.conf and the Okta enrollment link. For keys we use GitHub SSH + our internal approvals page. Steps:

```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "zoe@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | xclip -selection clipboard  # linux
```

Then paste to https://redwood.github.io/ssh-keys and request access to repos. If you prefer Mac for local tooling, we default to Mac M2 for ML infra folks, but Linux devboxes are available. Hardware stipend: $1,200 one-time to buy accessories (monitors, chairs, peripherals) — submit receipts to expense portal. 

Lina (People Ops): Hi Zoe 60a Welcome! Badge pickup: when you're in SF, choose "SF HQ pickup" on this form https://redwood.intranet/forms/badge and bring a photo ID. Onboarding emails (payroll/benefits) should be in your personal inbox --- check spam just in case. New-hire ritual: we do a 5-min intro in the weekly all-hands and a small welcome call with snacks (virtual snack card for remote folks). Socks are absolutely valid swag ask 61c

Daniel Cho: Hey Zoe 44b I'm your buddy for week one. Happy to pair on repo access and local infra. Quick offer: 30m pairing 8am PT tomorrow (that's 0:00 in Seoul) or later today 6pm PT (10am your time) — which works? Also FYI: we use an internal CA for dev services; add it to system trust to avoid TLS issues. On Ubuntu:

```
sudo cp /tmp/redwood-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/
sudo update-ca-certificates
```

Zoe Park: Thanks all 60a 6pm PT / 10am my time works great for pairing. I'll generate the SSH key now and paste the pubkey in the keys UI. Fun facts: 1) I taught myself to juggle, 2) I have a vintage Game Boy collection, 3) I'm allergic to coffee 62c (two truths and a lie?) 

Harpreet (IT): Noted on pairing. Also if you run into a blocked installer on Mac MDM, try running the install with sudo as a fallback and paste the console output here so I can triage. Example if installer fails:

```
sudo installer -pkg /tmp/RedwoodMDM.pkg -target /
```

BuddyBot: Zoe Park was added to #eng-ml-infra and #new-hires. :tada:

Lina (People Ops): Sent virtual welcome snack card to your email. We'll also add a "quirky socks" line to swag request. Welcome again!
